cases.title: Ticket Editor — create a ticket template
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user presses Create, enters a template name and selects a device type, then confirms
-> **THEN** a blank ticket template preview is displayed, bounded by the device's default paper dimensions and orientation

cases.title: Ticket Editor — add elements to a template
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user adds a fixed text element and a dynamic field element
-> **THEN** the fixed text is placed on the preview
**AND** the dynamic field name is shown in green on the preview
**WHEN** the user adds a logo/image and a line separator
-> **THEN** the logo is shown on the preview
**AND** the separator line is shown on the preview

cases.title: Ticket Editor — copy a template and change its device type
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user copies the template and changes the device type on the copy (e.g. ETM to POS)
-> **THEN** a separate template is created for the new device type

cases.title: Ticket Editor — configure a change ticket (NOT IN SPEC)
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user attempts to configure a change ticket
-> **THEN** **GAP** — 'change ticket' concept not defined; confirm live

cases.title: Product Editor — assign a ticket template to a product
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user selects a ticket template for the product/ticket type from the drop-down of available templates
-> **THEN** the ticket template is assigned to the product

cases.title: Ticket Editor — group a set of ticket layouts (NOT IN SPEC)
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user attempts to group a set of ticket templates
-> **THEN** **GAP** — no ticket-layout grouping feature exists; confirm live

cases.title: Ticket Editor — add a barcode to a template
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user selects the barcode tool and places a barcode at the end of the ticket
-> **THEN** a size-accurate representative barcode image is shown on the preview at the placed position

cases.title: Ticket Editor — add payment-card fields to a template
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the user adds the payment-card dynamic/optional fields to the template
-> **THEN** the obfuscated Payment Card Number field is added (REQ-1750.20)
**AND** the Payment Card Unique Reference Number field is added (REQ-1750.21)
**AND** the Printed Serial Number field is added (REQ-1750.18)
**WHEN** the user adds the card date fields
-> **THEN** the Card Start Date field is added (REQ-1750.17)
**AND** the Expiry Date field is added (REQ-1750.16)
